description: Send one webhook.test event to the follow-up's webhook address now, signed like every event, with the account ID and the access token (the same as POST /v1/payer-follow-ups/{id}/webhook/test). One try, no retries; returns whether a 2xx came back, the HTTP status, the error and how long it took. Refused (409) when no address is set: set one with payer_follow_up_webhook_set.

access_token.description: The access_token payer_follow_up_request returned (shown once), or the token in an emailed link.

name: payer_follow_up_webhook_test
title: Send a test event to a payer follow-up's webhook
